reviews.title: Paid only now?
reviews.text: A few nights ago my app started not opening. I still got sleep reminders notifications, but I couldn’t use the app. I decided to delete and re-install, which did fix the problem of not being able to open it. Only now, even though I signed in with my previous account, it says I have no progress or data saved. I lost months and months and months of gems and achievements. On top of that, it appears the app no longer has a free version and premium version - if I don’t agree to the seven day trial and paid version after that, I can’t access anything beyond the sign up questions. I am so incredibly frustrated and disappointed. Screw you guys.

reviews.title: Be Careful of Free Trial Trap
reviews.text:
In a weak moment, I impulsively accepted a seven day free trial of this app. The very next morning, my dog passed away in a traumatic and sudden event. I wasn't even using the app, and when I realized seven days later that I needed to cancel, I saw that I was charged on day six. I really didn't have a chance to try it out due to this tragic event occurring merely 12 hours after I began my free trial. I am unable to reverse the charge, and what's worse, I have been told they offer promotions that I could've taken advantage of. So whatever you do, don't pay the $79.99 charge for the year should you choose to sign up. They will freely offer you one year at $49.99. Learn from my very expensive mistake. Maybe the app is great. I am not sure. It evokes so many ill feelings and frustration in me, that I don't really desire to use or enjoy it. A very expensive lesson learned. They just pass the buck over to Apple, and Apple passed the buck to them. If you can fool everybody once, I guess you are getting somewhere.
what happened to me is not their fault, but they could have made adjustments like offering me a free second year to make up for it, or something like that. Nothing was done in an effort to make me happy. What I have seen on the app seems extremely similar to things I can find on YouTube for free. I will not be renewing and will warn others on as many platforms as I can that they really won't work with you on price adjustments if they don't have to.
